lessons: The requisition gate rejected pause-resume-activation because its Context names tests/test_daemon_pause.py. That file does not exist at authoring time; its dependency dispatch-pause-boundary creates it. Context may name only paths that already exist when the ticket is authored.

The ticket allows the fix: pause seeds put only their NOW-EXISTING fenced predecessor paths in Context, and sibling-new paths stay out. Remove tests/test_daemon_pause.py from pause-resume-activation Context and keep it in that ticket's Scope fence hooks.

Do not work around the lint in tests/test_seeded_phase3_08.py. Lint pause-resume-activation through lint_ticket like the other two seeds, and drop the special-case branch that only compares raw section text.

Update CONTEXT and the render-size map in the seeded test so tests/test_daemon_pause.py is not activation Context. Keep the assertions that tests/test_mergequeue.py and squatch/__main__.py are Context, as the acceptance criteria require.

Plan section 20's pause clarification says the activation Context retains test_daemon_pause.py, which conflicts with the rule that a seed never names a sibling-new path. Follow the ticket's now-existing rule and file the plan wording to the Suggestion Box.
reason: The ticket can be satisfied by removing the sibling-created file from activation Context; this failure was an authoring oversight, not proof the ticket is infeasible.
